title: Shahedeen Bayn Karte The Mere Beta Ali Akbar
body:
Shahedeen Bayn Karte The Mere Beta Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
zaeefi Me Pidar Hai Thokre Khata Ali Akbar
1.na Barchi Iske Seene Par Lagaao Aye Musalmano ke Hamshakle Payambar Hai,mera Beta Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
shahedeen Bayn Karte The Mere Beta Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kaha Laila Ne Akbar Ko Mila De Mujhse Aye Maalik
na Jaane Kho Gaya Jaaker,kaha Mera Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
shahedeen Bayn Karte The Mere Beta Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jawaan Ki Laash Uthani Hai Madad Ko Aaiye Baba
hussain Ibne Ali Padhte,the Ye Nauha Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
shahedeen Bayn Karte The Mere Beta Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
4.fughaan Karti Thi Har Bibi Ajab Manzar Tha Qaimo Me
chala Tha Rukhsate Aaqir,ko Jab Mera Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
shahedeen Bayn Karte The Mere Beta Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ali Ro Ro Ke Deti Thi Sada Ye Zainab E Muztar
haram Ko Yaad Aata Hai,tera Chehra Ali Akbar
